source_document: CLAUDE.md section 10 (Retrieval experiment contract) -- KURE-v1 / BGE-M3 / PIXIE-Rune

candidates.model_architecture: XLMRobertaModel, 24 layers -- fine-tuned from BAAI/bge-m3 via CachedGISTEmbedLoss on ~1.88M Korean query-document pairs. Pure bidirectional encoder, never a decoder-only/generative architecture.

normalization.mechanism: sentence-transformers pipeline module 2 = Normalize (L2), per modules.json

candidates.supported_languages: Korean, English (primary training focus); base BAAI/bge-m3 itself covers 100+ languages

estimated_memory_gb_range.basis: model.safetensors is 2.27GB (fp32, ~560M-param XLM-RoBERTa-large scale). Range assumes typical CPU inference overhead (activations, tokenizer, batching) on top of resident weights; not independently profiled this Turn (no model download performed).

candidates.competition_status_reason: Pure XLM-RoBERTa bidirectional encoder (via BAAI/bge-m3 lineage + RetroMAE pretraining), architecturally incapable of autoregressive generation -- not derived from any generative/decoder LLM (the CLAUDE.md concern, exemplified by the Qwen-embedding family, does not apply to this BERT/RoBERTa-lineage architecture). MIT license, immutable revision and dimension both confirmed from the official HuggingFace repository -- no blocker identified for a bounded, Gold-blind calibration smoke.

adapter_compatibility.reason: No provider-hosted official HTTP embeddings endpoint exists for this open-weight model. It CAN be served locally via HuggingFace's own Text Embeddings Inference (TEI), whose /v1/embeddings endpoint already accepts {input, model} and returns {data:[{embedding}]} -- byte-shape-compatible with the existing HTTP_EMBEDDINGS adapter contract with zero new protocol code. This Turn does not install or run any such server.

candidates.competition_status_reason: Official model card explicitly states the architecture is XLM-RoBERTa + RetroMAE, and that BGE-M3 'no longer requires adding instructions to the queries' (symmetric encoder, not an instruction-tuned generative-derived model). Architecturally incapable of autoregressive generation -- not the Qwen-style generative-LLM-derived pattern CLAUDE.md flags. MIT license, immutable revision and dimension both confirmed from the official HuggingFace repository -- no blocker identified for a bounded, Gold-blind calibration smoke.

adapter_compatibility.reason: No provider-hosted official HTTP embeddings endpoint exists (the 'text-embeddings-inference'/'endpoints_compatible' HF tags describe SELF-hostable deployment options, not an already-running BAAI-operated endpoint). Self-hosted TEI's /v1/embeddings endpoint is byte-shape-compatible with the existing HTTP_EMBEDDINGS adapter contract with zero new protocol code. This Turn does not install or run any such server.

candidates.competition_status_reason: CLAUDE.md names only 'PIXIE-Rune (실험 전 정확한 revision 고정)' with no version qualifier. THREE distinct, actively published repositories exist under this family name -- telepix/PIXIE-Rune-v1.0, telepix/PIXIE-Rune-v1.5, and telepix/PIXIE-Rune-Preview -- with different immutable revisions and (for at least Preview vs. v1.0/v1.5) potentially different characteristics. Per this Turn's own instruction (never guess an unresolvable identity/revision), no single repository_id is pinned here; see pixie_rune_variants_researched below for what IS independently confirmed about each. This is NOT a license/runtime/regulatory blocker -- it is an identity-resolution blocker requiring the organizer/owner to specify exactly which PIXIE-Rune build the competition means before any further pin or calibration step.

pixie_rune_variants_researched.note: earlier stable release; architecture/dimension not independently re-verified this Turn beyond the shared family README

latest stable release at research time; dimension=1024, max_seq_length=6144, pooling=CLS, query_prefix="query: ", document_prefix="" (asymmetric -- confirmed via config_sentence_transformers.json prompts object), Normalize module present. Reported by TelePIX as marginally outperforming v1.0 on STELLA/MTEB-Korean.
explicitly named 'Preview' -- presumed experimental/pre-release, not independently re-verified

adapter_compatibility.reason: Provisional, architecture-level judgment shared across all 3 known variants (all sentence-transformers XLM-RoBERTa checkpoints, same TEI-servable stack as KURE-v1/BGE-M3) -- NOT a confirmation that a specific pinned artifact is ready, since competition_status is BLOCKED_UNVERIFIED_MODEL_ID. Notably, v1.5 requires a query-only prefix ("query: ") applied asymmetrically to queries vs. documents -- any adapter wiring for this candidate must route text through a query/document-mode-aware preparation step, never embed the identical raw text the same way for both roles (see frozen-candidate-registry.mjs's prepareTextForMode).
